status: Source-bound proposed structural comparisons for three interfaces; no HAD, structure, waterproofing, service appliance, site or product adoption.

groundFloor.basis: warm domestic RC slab + threshold seat only. Geometry in current proposed support layout; not imported NW-W upstairs 25cover or site certification. Four independent H12 layers: EW and NS at BOTH faces, 100 centres, nominal45 outer cover, prescribed 40..50. Both faces and layers count in mass.
groundFloor.distanceVsOldAxis: old 4000mm at (4075,3975) is directly on the 600wide court-S concrete footprint. The new test requires uninterrupted actual slab between both support faces. No concrete is conjured across courtyard/stair/water territory.
groundFloor.thresholdSeat: 210mm cantilever is the known 1900x210 apron/seat beyond court-S; concentrated hardware duties are independent of this slab field check.
groundFloor.crackMethod: JRC Eurocode 2 worked examples, 2014, 7.3.4 form sr=3.4c+0.8*k2*0.425*bar/rhoeff. Deliberately neglect favourable tension-stiffening, full G+Q elastic cracked stress plus a separate 400microstrain upper restraint comparison using pure-tension k2=1.0. The 0.30mm is an authored structural comparison only, not acceptable gas transmission, liquid permeability or proof of lifetime crack width. Full restraint, unmodeled settlement and thermal exposure remain bounded hypotheses. https://eurocodes.jrc.ec.europa.eu/publications/eurocode-2-background-appications-design-concrete-buildings-worked-examples
groundFloor.pour: Preferred finite construction control: form a continuous upper200mm dry-floor lift (20.98m3 nominal), including the head/beam overlap once and the formed threshold seat. No planned full-depth intermediate joint in occupied field; if the lower grillage is cast first, structural horizontal construction interface is at underside -380 with prepared rough concrete and continuing reinforcement. Starter/interlock, real pour length, temperature/early-age restraint, interruption detail and any service penetrations still need coordinated design. Do not declare the construction joint airtight.
groundFloor.materials: C30/S500 only structural comparison. Composite RC density at or below25kN/m3 including the actual bars must be delivered for this load bound. Cement dose, constituent mix, permeability, curing, floor surface/air-wall seal and actual site/water exposure remain the material/source owners’ duties. 300kg/m3 or 40mm exposure hypothesis alone gives no admission.

localStripEconomy.base: H12/150 each face/two axes; add offset H12/150 each face only in the actual span direction at governing >0.30mm regions, resulting local75 rather than pretending to make 100 from 150. Includes650 beyond both receiving faces and 150 side extension clipped to real slab; boundary bars still require hook/anchorage. Plant point, lap extensions, threshold and re-entrant edge extras not included in this quantity.
localStripEconomy.decision: Simpler uniform100 is the bounded reproducible control. Compare this lower-mass reinforcement layout for actual cover/joint/scheduling rather than declaring dense steel a whole-house invariant.

formedShowerOpening.status: formed 400x400 structural opening candidate, conditional local trimmer/header section; actual drain, concentrated tray foot/bracket, reinstatement and support anchorage remain open
formedShowerOpening.detail: New bars continuous around the cast-out in prefixed mats, not cut by a saw. Before fabricating, establish support-end detailing within the 140mm exterior core and 200mm wet beam, edge opening transfer/crack service, actual crossing bar elevations, fire/acoustic/air floor classification and complete removable cover/tray support. The 2kN characteristic footprint challenge does not certify an unknown foot bearing or lifting operation.

receiverEndComparison.method: 3 EW bars per face per side. Bottoms at Z3237.5; ring bars at indicated centres, top EW at Z3335 (inside the upper edge, not its top bars). West bends selected in plan; east straight projection in actual 200-wide RC wet beam. Indicative 200 straight tails after 48mm internal mandrel, nominal 34mm between two parallel tails. No reduced development credit for hooks. New headers use two bars each face with at least actual calculated bending-stress development outside 240mm side strips, not an assumed full-yield anchorage.
receiverEndComparison.remaining: Check native floor mesh/closed stirrup avoidance and placement tolerance (6.5mm at closest ordinary lower ring crossing), actual concrete mandrel pressure and confinement, shear/edge/crack at the opening and cover frame, roof/edge ultimate combination and filled/removed/renewing states. A support reserve cannot prove the pan feet, shell handling or reversible fire/air closure.

aboveBridgeCarrier.case: The motion of a complete fixed flange is compared independently from the body. All dimensions provisional RWT research, not selected conveyance. Do not add contradictory cover assumptions as a single passing geometry.
aboveBridgeCarrier.sourceBinding: STR geometry: current-house-grid.json. Product/corridor proposals from RWT #1344 and 6 November design join; immutable evidence source must be refreshed if flange, pipe connection, rain duty, rod, rail or actual extraction changes.
aboveBridgeCarrier.warmFloor: Stone15/screed65/glass100 over RC200 top−180/bottom−380. The warm gallery/water withdrawal floor is not a −60 or −20 removable outdoor walking cover. With the tube body below −180, the travelling larger flange still hits the underside of the retained warm build-up and the RC slab. A body-only negative is not a whole assembly clearance.
aboveBridgeCarrier.anchorage: A top recess keeps the low straight bottom bar path used by the original450 field. It cuts the unaltered upper bars/closed torsion links; a formed lower top cage, anchorage into the known −250/−290 node layers, and local notch interface/sidewall are additional physical changes. Body-only depth330 or370 is not an assembled pipe/renewal pass. Test the loaded outer1.8m member independently of the two1.6m members. The full285 flange plus below-warm-stack alternative removes most field depth and intersects the continuous gallery slab; do not specify a recess or underfloor extraction as though only three isolated ribs existed.
aboveBridgeCarrier.decision: Do not adopt the above-bridge route, excavate the structural core, or change levels. Preserve 450mm formed field and under-bridge option as the controlling unmodified geometry. A removable pipe joint, continuous accessible warm-floor/channel and priceable alternative support could reopen a different route; a thin outdoor cover or body-only envelope does not.
